notes: All state-mutating entry points (stake/withdraw/claim/emergencyWithdraw/migrateOut/depositFor) carry OZ ReentrancyGuard nonReentrant; migrateOut/depositFor are also onlyMigrator. StableStakerMigrator.migrate is onlyOwner. Semgrep produced only INFO-level gas/style rules (use-custom-error, prefix-increment, ownable2step, etc.) -> all discarded. Slither uninitialized-local on totalPrincipal/total/migratedCount are accumulator vars that Solidity zero-initializes -> false positives, discarded. naming/pragma/too-many-digits/missing-inheritance/missing-zero-check discarded per noise filter.

findings.description: phUSD.mint(u, pending) (line 327) is an external call made before state writes pool.totalStaked -= amt (322), info.amount = 0 (320), info.rewardDebt = 0 (321). poolInfo/userInfo are read by view fns (pendingReward) and other mutators. Aderyn independently flags the same state-change-after-external-call at line 327 as HIGH.
findings.rawCheck: reentrancy-no-eth / Reentrancy: State change after external call
findings.triageNote: Function is nonReentrant AND onlyMigrator. The external callee is phUSD (trusted protocol mint). Real reentrancy requires a malicious phUSD or migrator. Likely CEI-ordering QA unless phUSD mint hook is attacker-controllable. Highest-signal item in changed file; warrants manual confirmation of phUSD mint trust.

findings.description: In stake(), _settle()->phUSD.mint and _routeDeposit()->strategy.deposit are external calls before state writes pool.totalStaked += received (231), user.amount/rewardDebt (230,232).
findings.triageNote: nonReentrant guarded. Cross-function reentrancy set (pendingReward etc.) all guarded or view. Exploitability hinges on strategy.deposit being an untrusted external contract (owner-set IYieldStrategy). Manual check: can a malicious/owner-set strategy reenter a non-guarded path? All mutators are guarded, so low real-signal -> QA/CEI.

findings.description: Same pattern as stake: _settle->phUSD.mint and _routeDeposit->strategy.deposit precede pool.totalStaked += received (371) and userInfo writes (370,372).
findings.triageNote: nonReentrant + onlyMigrator. Mirror of SA-002; same trust analysis (phUSD mint, owner-set strategy).

findings.description: EnumerableSet add()/remove() return values ignored at lines 233 (stake), 250 (withdraw), 287 (emergencyWithdraw), 323 (migrateOut), 373 (depositFor). Aderyn flags the same five as 'Unchecked Return'.
findings.triageNote: EnumerableSet add/remove are idempotent; ignoring the bool is conventional and harmless here (staker-set membership). QA-level. Worth a glance that no logic depends on first-time-add detection.

findings.description: External call phUSD.mint(u, pending) (327) inside a per-user loop; Migrator.migrate likewise calls newStaker.depositFor inside a loop (Migrator.sol:62). Aderyn: 'Costly operations inside loop' at StableStaker.sol:312.
findings.triageNote: Batch size is operator-controlled (onlyMigrator/onlyOwner). DoS-by-gas only if user array is unbounded and externally forced; here caller is privileged. QA / griefing-bounded.

findings.description: YieldStrategySet event emitted after external strategy.deposit(token, idleBalance, address(this)) at line 198.
findings.triageNote: onlyOwner; event-ordering only, no state corruption. Informational. Migrator.migrate has analogous reentrancy-events (Migrated emitted after migrateOut/depositFor) - same low signal.

findings.description: Address state variables set without zero-address validation: setPauser (159) and setMigrator (166). Aderyn 'Address State Variable Set Without Checks'; Slither 'missing-zero-check' at 158/164.
findings.triageNote: onlyOwner setters. Zeroing pauser/migrator is a recoverable owner mistake (Known-Invalid: reckless admin). QA at best; retained for completeness only.
